title: Deleting a customer-named category moves its parts to Uncategorized
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, named after a customer, with its own matrix, matrix A.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A, in category A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, with part A on a line priced by matrix A; note its price.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A.
  3. Open the category page's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Delete.
  5. Click Delete in the dialog.
  6. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed with matrix A.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The menu offers Audit Log and Delete.

Step 4:

  • The "Delete" dialog for category A opens with Cancel and Delete.

Step 5:

  • Category A is no longer listed.
  • Part A's category is Uncategorized.

Step 6:

  • Part A's line shows category Uncategorized.
  • The line keeps the noted price.
